hook: Karen Simonyan studied at the University of Oxford, working in the Visual Geometry Group under Andrew Zisserman. In 2014 the pair published Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition, known as VGGNet, which showed that stacking small 3x3 convolutional filters into very deep networks of 16 to 19 layers produced strong image classification results. He joined DeepMind, where he worked on multimodal and generative systems including WaveNet and later large multimodal models. In 2022 he co-founded Inflection AI with Reid Hoffman and Mustafa Suleyman as chief scientist, and in 2024 moved to Microsoft as part of the team that formed Microsoft AI.
name: Karen Simonyan

primary.name: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition (arXiv)

timeline.event: Publishes Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition with Andrew Zisserman
timeline.impact: VGGNet placed highly in the ImageNet Challenge 2014 and became a standard backbone for transfer learning in computer vision.
Worked on generative modeling and multimodal AI research.

timeline.event: Co-founds Inflection AI with Mustafa Suleyman and Reid Hoffman
timeline.impact: Served as chief scientist building the Pi conversational assistant.
Moved with most of the Inflection AI research team to build a new in-house AI division at Microsoft.

quick_facts: Studied at the University of Oxford in the Visual Geometry Group under Andrew Zisserman
Co-authored VGGNet, one of the most cited architectures in computer vision
Researcher at DeepMind on generative and multimodal systems
Co-founded Inflection AI in 2022 as chief scientist

achievements.title: VGGNet
achievements.impact: Demonstrated that increasing convolutional network depth with small uniform filters substantially improves image recognition accuracy, becoming a widely used backbone architecture and transfer-learning baseline.

achievements.title: Two-stream convolutional networks for action recognition
achievements.impact: Introduced an approach for combining spatial and motion information in video understanding that shaped later video recognition work.

achievements.title: Co-founding Inflection AI
achievements.impact: Helped build Pi, a consumer conversational AI assistant, before the founding team joined Microsoft in 2024.
